title: Billy Reid x Gibson Western Shirt

long_description.body:
Straight from Muscle Shoals to Music Row, and now, to you, Gibson has partnered with award-winning Florence, Alabama-based fashion designer Billy Reid on a very limited collection inspired by the iconic Gibson Hummingbird™ guitar. For this Western Shirt, Billy Reid took one of their favorite heritage styles and gave it a jacquard print of our exclusive collaboration pattern, designed by Billy himself and woven in France. Then they finished it with signature details like spade-shaped flap pockets at the chest and genuine horn buttons.



100% Cotton
Made in Turkey
Machine wash cold
Model is 6'2" wearing size M
Standard fit
Relaxed through the chest, body, and sleeves
